reviews.comment: GOATed professor. Had my reservations for the class since but Dr. Connors was nothing but caring and understanding. Gives good feedback on discussions and essays.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Arguably one of the best professors at TAMU.

He is such a great prof. I had him before too and I love his classes. His lectures are informative and engaging. Work was really easy and so were the in class quizzes where you could have a cheat sheet. Lab was tedious but not difficult. Highly recommend him!

one of the best professors ive had in my three years at tamu. really cares about what he is teaching and that makes the class 100% better. no exams, just quizzes and writing assignments over various documentaries. he's also pretty stylish and showed us pics of his cute kids. great professor
Great professor

Dr. Casellas Connors is such a great professor! It's easy to see that he really cares about what he is teaching and wants to see his students succeed. There are no exams, rather 5 quizzes where you can use a notes sheet, and some writing assignments that I thought were very interesting. One of my favorite Profs in college so far! Take this class!!

He is an amazing lecturer, but can talk so fast!! He is very knowledgeable and clearly loves what he is talking about. There are a variety of assignments. There are no exams but documentary responses, quizzes, and discussion post.

Lecture heavy but makes it interesting and is probably the best lecturer in the geography department by a milestone at Texas A&M. Super knowledgeable of the material and always comes to lectures prepared. Only complaint is there is 0 feedback in terms of grading other than the grade received.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Theres a reason his rate my professor is so good. By far the best professor Ive ever taken. His lectures are long but he is so captivating to listen to. Quizzes are open note and always exactly what the review sheet lists. There are discussions and documentary responses but theyre pretty easy too. Take him!!!! I promise you wont regret.

Dr. Casellas Connors is an outstanding professor. He is clearly very passionate about the topic he discusses, and wants to help his students succeed. He lets you bring a page of notes for the quizzes and is very understanding with assignments, dropping the lowest grades for several categories. Highly recommend!

Professor Casellas Connors is incredibly knowledgable and passionate about what he teaches, and his lectures are interesting, relevant, and relatable. No exams; Only short quizzes, documentary reflections, and discussions. Attending class is not mandatory, but your attendance gets graded by in class activities. Come to class and an A is easy!

My favorite class and professor so far. Lectures were very engaging, assignments were graded fairly, and quizzes were not too hard. We had participation assignments, but I would have gone even if it was an 8 am because Dr. Casellas Connors' lectures were really good and connected concepts well. There was extra credit and assignments were dropped.
Best professor I've had so far. Very passionate during lectures and very understanding about grades. Also pretty funny.

Really chill, understanding professor. Despite this class having an early morning lecture, I looked forward to coming to class and felt I learned a lot. Attending class is highly recommended as graded classwork is 50% of the overall course grade. No exams but had pretty easy chapter quizzes every couple weeks. Highly recommend!

His lectures were interesting and I liked the discussions in class. He has open notes quizzes every few sections instead of exams which made the class less stressful. He drops the lowest discussion and quiz grade and some absent attendances. It doesn't take long to get grades back and you have to calculate your final grade yourself at the end.

This is one of the best profs I have ever had. He is incredibly passionate and knowledgeable, and very well spoken. The topics are a little complex, but his class requires critical thinking. Definitely recommend attending lectures, firstly because they are the most important thing to your grade, secondly because they are, in my opinion, applicable.

Very lecture-heavy, all the info comes from his lecture slides. He stopped giving exams and has transitioned to giving 6 quizzes and multiple discussion posts and documentary responses. The quizzes were all open notes and the written responses were fairly easy as long as you paid attention in class. Dr. Casellas Connors was also very understanding.

Professor Connors has the most interesting lectures. He is a great lecture giver and there is not a moment where you are bored. He gives extra credit for watching speakers and all grades come from attendance every other week, discussion posts and quizzes every other week. GEOG 330 was a fascinating class and he taught it SO well. Highly recommend.

He was a good prof for GEOG 330. He was obviously very passionate about the subjects we talked about, and made assignments grading in class very fair. By far my least stressful class of the semester. You could tell he cared about the students and most have a big respect for him.

Needed a core class out of the way but (surprisingly) enjoyed this one. Lectures are clear and easy to listen to/take notes from, and he posts study guides for all tests. If you can convince yourself to be interested for a semester and not treat it like a chore, it's a good time.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: 3 exams you can definitely ace if you study. Attendance isn't taken, but he puts questions on the powerpoint that have to be responded to in Ecampus for credit. A few assignments that required watching documentaries, but they were really interesting. If you have to take the class, take him!

Very passionate about his material. Lecture intensive course, with 8-10 complementary short(a paragraph or two) written assignments throughout the year. 4 longer assignments, usually over a film or documentary. Tests are very easy if you review the provided study guide with the powerpoints.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: AMAZING PROF. He's really passionate about geography and world issues and is really knowledgeable about the subject. I really loved hearing him lecture and the participation assignments are easy. Take him if you can!

He's a super nice guy with great style, and he made having an 8am so much better than it could be. As long as you show up to class and maaaaybe read the books he assigns once in a while you do great. The in class assignments are a great grade booster if you don't do so well on the exam or final.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very bias towards the leftist perspective. Very brainwashed and hard to take seriously. DO NOT take if you want to feel like you aren't wasting your time.

I took him two semesters in a row and he was a phenomenal professor both times. If you are struggling or having a bad semester, he is very understanding and will go out of his way to show you what you need to improve upon. He makes it very clear how to succeed in his class. He has been one of my favorite professors at TAMU.
Great professor, he's younger so it's easier to relate to him. He recommended buying three books the first day, I didn't get one of them and didn't struggle too hard.

I had Dr. Connors for GEOG330, last semester, and I'm so glad I had him again for GIS. This class was very complex, but he was able to explain the concepts to where it was easier to understand. Lecture was ok, but the lab portion took up a lot of time. DON'T PROCRASTINATE on the labs!

John is a great professor and he is able to explain complicated concepts in simple terms. He really knows the information and is very passionate about this subject. Consider yourself blessed if you get this professor, but don't assume that its an easy A. He still wants you to put in some work, but its a very interesting class. This guy is the best.

Fantastic professor! He really tries to encompass everything in a great flow for the material to learn. He engages the audience and really wants the students to get an understanding of even the most seemingly complicated topics. Aside from being stylish and attractive, he goes above and beyond to help during reviews and book reviews! Dr.C-C rocks!

Professor Connors is amazing and he tries to make the class as simple as possible (interesting subject, but not the simplest). He is also there if you have any problems with how you are doing in the class. He seems very passionate about his work and is very knowledgeable about GIS & GEOG, consider yourself lucky if you get him :)
Coolest guy on the block. Style straight out of J Crew, said to be a banana republic god. Very color coordinated. Great teacher and very caring. John if you are reading this you are rad.

Dr. Connors is one of the best profs I've had so far. You can tell he's really passionate about what he does because he makes the lectures interesting and engaging. He does random attendance notecards, and if you miss more than three, he'll drop you a letter grade. Shouldn't be a problem, though, because you actually want to go to his class.

Dr. Connors is one of the best professors I've ever had. He truly cares about what he is teaching and that passion radiates through in his lectures. He does have quite a strict attendance policy: miss 3 or more classes with unexcused absences and he drops you a letter grade. Otherwise, he is a brilliant professor and I would recommend taking him.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Casellas Connors is an amazing professor that definitely dresses to impress! I enjoyed taking GEOG 330 with him because he really has a passion for the material and has very well planned and interactive lectures. He does take attendance often and you need to read outside of class but they are helpful overall experience to the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational
